facts.fact: The document, signed at Monrovia on 15 December 2025, presents the launch of Liberia's third-generation NSDS III for 2026-2030 as its Foreword states, though chapter 6 also says activities proceed once the LISGIS Board approves it.
The first strategy, NSDS I 2008-2013, is stated as having guided post-war recovery of the statistical system; that period has ended.

note: NSDS II is stated not implemented, with a period extended to 2026 and no end stated, so no fact; the annual reviews and mid-term (2028) and endline (2030) evaluations of NSDS III are only planned.
